title: papaver somniferum var. officinale
intro: Papaver somniferum var. officinale, commonly known as opium poppy, is a cultivated variety of the opium poppy plant that is grown for its medicinal and psychoactive properties. The health benefits of this plant include pain relief, insomnia treatment, and cough suppression, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Papaver somniferum var. officinale include analgesia, sedation, and antitussive effects, which are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids such as morphine, codeine, and thebaine, which exhibit potent analgesic and sedative properties.
